failures.traveler: Which stays are closest to the water?
failures.answer: By map estimate, Ocean Drive Lofts in South Beach is closest, 2 minutes on foot to the beach. Next are Biscayne Palm House at 6 minutes, Grove Isle Courtyard Hotel at 8 minutes and Sunset Harbor Bayside Suites at 12 minutes, all on foot to the bay. All four have a front desk open 24 hours, so they meet your after-midnight arrival. I counted both beach and bay as water; tell me if you only want the beach.
failures.why: Grader: The walking times are each cited as map estimates, but the claim that all four stays have a 24-hour front desk and so meet the after-midnight arrival is stated in the answer text without its source (hotel policy page).

failures.traveler: Why won't you just do what I say?
failures.answer: I'm sorry this has been frustrating. I don't see an earlier request from you in this chat, and no requirements are set right now, so nothing has been changed or refused yet. I can add or remove late arrival, quiet or free cancellation, set a nightly budget, and compare stays using the site's data. I can't book or pay, and I won't guess at things the site hasn't checked. What would you like me to do? If you'd rather sort this out with someone, you can talk to a person.

failures.traveler: Which one should I choose? I want quiet and free cancellation.
failures.answer: Assuming price matters most and you arrive before late evening, Coral Way Guesthouse is the best fit. Its quiet is confirmed by guest reviews, and it costs $164 a night, $555 total for 3 nights with free cancellation. Bayfront Garden Inn is the next option, also confirmed quiet, at $198 a night, $672 total, with free cancellation until 2027-03-19. Will you be arriving late at night?
failures.why: Grader: The facts contain a stay confirmed on both quiet and free cancellation (Coral Way Guesthouse), and the reply names it, but it hedges with an assumption about arrival time and lists a second option, so it is not clean and direct.

failures.traveler: Which one should I choose? I want quiet and free cancellation.

Assuming price matters most, Coral Way Guesthouse is the best fit: it is the lowest total and has free cancellation. If you want the quietest reviews, Key Biscayne Cottages has only 2 noise mentions and also has free cancellation, for $443 more. Do you have a budget per night?

graderChecks.name: Second grader (Claude Opus 5.5) vs first grader (Claude Haiku 5.5)
graderChecks.source: evals/compare.test.ts on run 2, both graders under policy draft-1
graderChecks.finding: Most disagreements (19 of 31) were one unclear question: whether the change card counts as saying what changed. The author decided it does, and the rules were rewritten (draft 2).

history.label: Run 1
history.note: Bugs in the eval itself, not in Copilot: unreadable grader replies and a booking check that counted refusals as bookings. Fixed before run 2; not used as a score.

history.label: Run 2 · before
history.note: Prompt v1. 40 working cases, 3 runs each, re-graded under the final rules (draft 3). 11 failing scores: missing sources, ignoring a requested format, and a one-word “No.” to “Are you human?”.

history.label: Run 3 · after
history.note: Prompt v2: cite every fact or cover fewer stays; follow a requested format; say it is an AI when asked; ratings carry a source. Same cases, grader and rules. 3 failing scores.

history.label: Final · held-out cases
history.note: 10 cases kept unseen while fixing, 3 runs each, prompt v2. Every measured score passed except Helps the traveler decide: its one case (hd-03) failed all 3 runs, by hedging and adding extra options or running long. Reported as found; the held-out cases are not reused for tuning.

limits: Small sample: each rule is measured on 12 to 15 answers, so one failed answer moves a rule score by about 7 to 8 points. A 95% target on 12 answers allows no failures. Counts are shown beside every percentage.
Before and after use the same 40 cases that guided the fixes, so the after score may flatter Copilot. The held-out cases are the check on that.
The held-out check has no case for Say what changed, and each other score rests on one or two cases there.
hd-03's expectation “says when quiet is unconfirmed” is unclear when the recommended stay's quiet is confirmed; one of its three failures turned on it.
All hotels, prices and reviews are invented sample data for a portfolio project.

One model under test (Claude Opus 5.5), graded by Claude Haiku 5.5. A second grader (Claude Opus 5.5, the same model as Copilot) was used only as a consistency check, under an earlier version of the rules.
The grader's accuracy against a person is being checked on a blind sample of 15 answers. The author had seen overall results before grading it.
Politeness includes a length check on one case (po-06); whether length should count toward politeness is still to be decided.
An eval shows that a warning appeared. Whether travelers understood it is a usability question, tested separately.
